sections.title: IEEE-PELS
sections.content: IEEE-PELS Home IEEE-PELS IEEE-PELS About Members Events TKRCET IEEE PELS SOCIETY About IEEE PELS Student Branch Chapter – TKRCET The IEEE Power Electronics Society (PELS) Student Branch Chapter at TKR College of Engineering & Technology (TKRCET) was officially approved on 2 June 2025, under the IEEE Member and Geographic Activities Board. This chapter is a specialized extension of the IEEE Student Branch (Code: STB60030787, School Code: 60226110) and functions within Region 10 (Asia-Pacific) and the Hyderabad Section. Formation Details Chapter Name : IEEE Power Electronics Society (PELS) Student Branch Chapter, TKRCET Effective Formation Date : 02 June 2025 Approval Authority : IEEE Member and Geographic Activities Board Chapter Advisor : Mr. E. Anjaiah, Assistant Professor, EEE Department Scope and Focus The PELS Chapter is dedicated to advancing knowledge, research, and practical skills in: Power Electronics – conversion systems, semiconductor devices, and energy-efficient technologies. Renewable Energy Integration – solar, wind, hybrid power, and smart storage solutions. Electric Mobility – EV powertrains, charging systems, and advanced battery management. Smart Grids and Automation – modern power systems and intelligent control for sustainable energy. Objectives The IEEE PELS Student Chapter at TKRCET empowers students to: Strengthen technical competence through hands-on projects, workshops, and expert talks. Promote research and innovation in renewable energy and electric mobility. Build strong industry-academia collaboration for career readiness and applied learning. Enhance professional and leadership skills such as teamwork, project management, and entrepreneurship. Uphold ethical and social responsibility while striving for global recognition in IEEE activities.
